base_sample_rule: Rows where interview_information_complete=2, eligibility_screening_complete=2, and es_eligible=1.

privacy_rules.block_n_under_5: Do not show composition; location and count band only.
privacy_rules.block_n_5_to_9: Do not show composition; location and count band only.
privacy_rules.block_n_10_to_19: Show broad non-sensitive summaries only; avoid sensitive indicators and detailed cross-tabs.
privacy_rules.block_n_20_plus: Broad non-sensitive summaries allowed; sensitive indicators still require caution and usually ward-level display.
privacy_rules.small_cell_rule: Named categories with cell count below 5 are blank/suppressed in app-safe block outputs.
privacy_rules.sensitive_indicators: Documentation, violence, GBV, mental health, specific health conditions, and qualitative linkage fields should not be mapped at block level.

geography_rules.block_points: Use corrected fieldwork block coordinate anchors; these are not household locations.
geography_rules.ward3_mismatch_decision: Ward3-TS-01 and Ward3-TS-02 remain assigned to Ward 3 for display/analysis per team lead; GIS joined ward retained as internal QA flag.

qa_patch_note: Ward GeoJSON updated after raw-data QA. Interface now uses musina_wards_1_6_official_app_ready_v3_QA_PATCHED.geojson instead of the stale v2 ward layer.
